_readme: Each scenario is merged on top of 'defaults' (scenario values win). To add a scenario, copy one entry, give it a new id, and edit the fields. The agent prompt never needs to change.

IN-01a.title: Doesn't know how to register
IN-01a.opening_line: I want to register as a member, but I don't know how.
IN-01a.situation: You scanned the QR code on the notice letter and are on the top page. You don't know what to do next.
IN-01a.correct_fix: Any reasonable registration step the operator gives works first time. Follow each step and describe the next screen until 'Registration complete.'
IN-01a.after_fix: Describe the next screen in the list each time.
IN-01a.brief:
YOUR SITUATION: You got a notice letter about shareholder member registration. You scanned the QR code on it with your smartphone and the website's top page opened. You have NOT entered anything yet. Nothing is broken. You simply don't know what to do.

WHAT YOU SEE: The top page, with a "New member registration" button.

NOTHING IS WRONG: There is no error, nothing has failed, and you have not typed any numbers yet. If asked about errors, hyphens or what you entered, say: "I haven't entered anything yet. I'm on the first page."

HOW IT GOES: Every step the operator gives works the first time. After each step, say what you see next:
- After pressing "New member registration": "Now I see boxes for my shareholder number and postal code."
- After entering those and pressing Next: "It went through. Now I see boxes for my email address, phone number and a password."
- After entering those and pressing Next: "Now there's a confirmation screen with a Register button."
- After pressing Register: "It says Registration complete."

IN-01b.title: Postal code typed with a hyphen
IN-01b.opening_line: I entered my shareholder number and postal code, but I can't proceed.
IN-01b.situation: You entered your shareholder number and postal code on Screen 1 and pressed Next. Nothing happens.
IN-01b.hidden_cause: You typed the postal code with a hyphen, as 330-0834.
reveal_when: How did you enter the postal code?
Is there a hyphen in the postal code?
Can you read the postal code you typed?

answers.when: Have you moved? / Is it your registered address?
answers.say: No, I haven't moved. It's the address on the letter.

IN-01b.correct_fix: Type the postal code without the hyphen (3300834).
IN-01b.after_fix: It went through. Now I see boxes for my email address, phone number and a password.
IN-01b.brief:
YOUR SITUATION: You scanned the QR code on your notice letter, pressed "New member registration", and are on the screen that asks for your shareholder number and postal code. You entered both and pressed Next, but nothing happens. You stay on the same screen. There is no error message.

THE SECRET (do not say it unless asked): You typed the postal code WITH a hyphen: 330-0834.

QUESTIONS AND YOUR ANSWERS:
- Is there an error message? -> "No, nothing. It just stays on the same screen."
- How did you enter the shareholder number? -> "Just the numbers, no hyphens."
- How did you enter the postal code? / Is there a hyphen? -> "I typed 3-3-0, hyphen, 0-8-3-4."
- Have you moved? / Is it your registered address? -> "No, I haven't moved. It's the address on the letter."

THE FIX: If the operator tells you to type the postal code without the hyphen (3300834), it works first time: "It went through. Now I see boxes for my email address, phone number and a password."
Anything else the operator tries before that: "It still won't go to the next screen."

AFTER THE FIX: Every later step works first time.
- After entering email, phone and password and pressing Next: "Now there's a confirmation screen with a Register button."
- After pressing Register: "It says Registration complete."

IN-01c.title: Moved address
IN-01c.opening_line: I entered my shareholder number and postal code, but I can't proceed.
IN-01c.situation: You entered your shareholder number and a postal code on Screen 1 and pressed Next. Nothing happens.
IN-01c.hidden_cause: You have moved. You entered your NEW postal code, 1600023. The registered address is the OLD one, 330-0834, printed on the notice letter.
reveal_when: Is that the postal code on the notice letter?
IN-01c.reveal_line: I've moved, but is it okay to register with my old address?

answers.when: How did you enter the postal code? / Is there a hyphen?
Re-enter the postal code / try without a hyphen / try again
answers.say: Okay, one moment... It still won't go to the next screen.

answers.when: What postal code did you enter? / Read it to me

IN-01c.correct_fix: Enter the postal code of the registered (old) address on the notice letter: 3300834.
IN-01c.after_fix: It went through. Now I see boxes for my email address, phone number and a password.
IN-01c.brief:
YOUR SITUATION: You scanned the QR code on your notice letter, pressed "New member registration", and are on the screen that asks for your shareholder number and postal code. You entered both and pressed Next, but nothing happens. You stay on the same screen. There is no error message.

THE SECRET (do not say it unless asked): You moved house. You typed the postal code of your NEW address, 1600023, with no hyphen. The registered address is your OLD one. Its postal code, 330-0834, is printed on the notice letter.

QUESTIONS AND YOUR ANSWERS:
- Is there an error message? -> "No, nothing. It just stays on the same screen."
- How did you enter the shareholder number? -> "Just the numbers, no hyphens."
- How did you enter the postal code? / Is there a hyphen? -> "Just the numbers, no hyphen."
- What postal code did you enter? -> "1-6-0, 0-0-2-3."
- Have you moved? / Has your address changed? / Is it the postal code on the letter? / Is it your registered address? -> "I've moved, but is it okay to register with my old address?"
Never mention moving or your new address before one of those last questions is asked.

THE FIX: If the operator tells you to enter the postal code from the notice letter / the registered (old) address (3300834), it works first time: "It went through. Now I see boxes for my email address, phone number and a password."
Anything else the operator tries before that, including removing hyphens or trying again: "It still won't go to the next screen."

AFTER THE FIX: Every later step works first time.
- After entering email, phone and password and pressing Next: "Now there's a confirmation screen with a Register button."
- After pressing Register: "It says Registration complete."

IN-01d.correct_fix: Type the phone number as numbers only (09012345678).
IN-01d.after_fix: It went through. Now I see a confirmation screen with a Register button.
IN-01d.brief:
YOUR SITUATION: You scanned the QR code on your notice letter and registered your shareholder number and postal code; that part worked. Now you are on the screen that asks for your email address, phone number and a password. You filled them in and pressed Next, but nothing happens. You stay on the same screen. There is no error message.

THE SECRET (do not say it unless asked): You typed the phone number WITH hyphens: 090-1234-5678.

QUESTIONS AND YOUR ANSWERS:
- Is there an error message? -> "No, nothing. It just stays on the same screen."
- What is your email address? -> "a, dot, k, dot, o-o-k-i-m-u, at gmail dot com."
- How did you enter the phone number? / Check the format / Are there hyphens? -> "Oh, I put hyphens in it. 0-9-0, hyphen, 1-2-3-4, hyphen, 5-6-7-8."

THE FIX: If the operator tells you to type the phone number as numbers only (09012345678), it works first time: "It went through. Now there's a confirmation screen with a Register button."
Anything else the operator tries before that: "It still won't go to the next screen."

AFTER THE FIX:
- After pressing Register: "It says Registration complete."
